# Kuailu HR | Core Advantages

| Advantage | Evidence-backed capability |
| --- | --- |
| Compliance-oriented calculations | Sales material highlights 468 Hours Compliance and statutory ADW / MPF calculations. |
| Dynamic payroll | Payroll templates and rules combine attendance, compensation, tax, social insurance and other inputs for period calculation. |
| Connected employee lifecycle | Onboarding, regularization, transfer and offboarding workflows can write back to employee, attendance and compensation records. |
| Configurable attendance operations | Attendance groups, fixed / scheduled / flexible / free shifts, scheduling, leave rules, forms and reports support varied workforce patterns. |
| Traceable operations | Profiles, forms, approvals, reports, export and audit-oriented records support follow-up and verification. |
